{{short description|American environmentalist}}
{{Moresources|date=February 2024}}

'''Wallace Hampton Tucker''' is an American award-winning [[playwright]],<ref>{{cite web |title=The SETI Institute Celebrates Native American Heritage Month |url=https://www.seti.org/seti-institute-celebrates-native-american-heritage-month |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240521043015/https://www.seti.org/seti-institute-celebrates-native-american-heritage-month |archive-date=21 May 2024}}</ref> and an active [[environmentalist]].

==Early life==
Tucker was born in [[McAlester, Oklahoma]] of partial [[Choctaw]] descent. He graduated from McAlester High School where he met his future wife, Karen.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.fallbrooklandconservancy.org/News/Chronicles/Feb2009/chronicle.htm |title=Fallbrook Land Conservancy |website=www.fallbrooklandconservancy.org |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110909133531/http://www.fallbrooklandconservancy.org/News/Chronicles/Feb2009/chronicle.htm |archive-date=2011-09-09}} </ref>

==Education==
Tucker attended the [[University of Oklahoma]] and where he earned his [[bachelor's degree]] in [[mathematics]] and [[Master's degree|Master's]] in [[physics]]. He continued his education from there and received his [[Ph.D.]] in physics from the [[University of California, San Diego]] in 1966.<ref>Geiogamah, Hanay, & Darby, Jaye T. (1999). ''Stories of Our Ways: An Anthology of American Indian Plays''. Regents of the University of California.</ref>

He has been active in environmental work, helping to found and lead two nonprofit organizations in Southern California: the Fallbrook Land Conservancy (FLC) and the San Diego Land Conservation Coalition. The FLC was formed in 1988. It has acquired and manages over 1850 acres of open space on 10 preserves throughout [[San Diego County]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Our Land |url=https://www.fallbrooklandconservancy.org/our-land |access-date=19 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241114043903/https://www.fallbrooklandconservancy.org/our-land |archive-date=14 November 2024}}</ref>
